purpose_context: Spec Kitty ships a set of built-in agent profiles (Debugger Debbie, Java Jenny, Python Pedro, Node Norris) that give missions stack-specific expertise. Drupal work currently has no such persona, so Drupal-specific conventions, module structure, and community practice are not represented in routing or governance. This mission adds 'Drupalling Dries' as a first-class built-in profile, seeded from a community AGENTS.md for Drupal plus whatever the existing profile contract requires.
purpose_tldr: Add a built-in Drupal-specialist agent profile so Spec Kitty missions can route Drupal work to an expert persona.
source_description: Distilled from amazee.io drupal-agents-md, Vanilla variant (https://github.com/amazeeio/drupal-agents-md/blob/main/Vanilla/AGENTS.md); usage mode B — mined for Drupal domain facts and re-expressed in this repository's artifact contracts, not copied verbatim.
